attrs.why_open: RETARGETED AT R6.1, and the retargeting is the finding. R5.2 pointed this doubt at ARG-FED-SEP-PROTOCOL-CITATION — the CORRECTNESS argument — while the doubt's own text said tractability is not claimed there and named FED-SEP-TRACT as the separate open question. Correctness (the protocol computes the right result) and tractability (it computes it efficiently) are different propositions, and attacking the first with a doubt about the second degraded an assurance state for a reason the record itself disclaimed. It now rebuts the open question it was always about. Eliminating it needs a cost model for unary projections over a realistic block language, which nothing in this tree has.
